description: This file defines CLI commands for managing browser profiles and tabs, including starting, stopping, resetting profiles, listing tabs, opening/closing/focusing tabs, and creating/deleting profiles. It uses external modules for command handling and API requests.

methods.name: resolveProfileQuery
methods.description: Constructs a query object for profile-based requests.

methods.name: printJsonResult
methods.description: Outputs payload as JSON if parent.json is true.

methods.name: callTabAction
methods.description: Performs tab actions like new, select, close.

methods.name: runBrowserToggle
methods.description: Starts or stops the browser based on profile and path.

methods.name: runBrowserCommand
methods.description: Wraps a command with runtime error handling.

methods.name: logBrowserTabs
methods.description: Logs list of open browser tabs.

methods.name: usesChromeMcpTransport
methods.description: Checks if transport is chrome-mcp or driver is existing-session.

methods.name: formatBrowserConnectionSummary
methods.description: Formats connection info string based on transport, remote, or port.

methods.name: registerBrowserManageCommands
methods.description: Registers CLI commands for browser management (status, start, stop, reset-profile, tabs, tab, profiles, create-profile, delete-profile).
